fields.description: Defaults to the default Company if left empty (see validate() in site_visit.py)
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Must be set before submitting - not required yet when saving as a draft (e.g. via the timer).
fields.label: Project

fields.description: Must be set before submitting - not required yet when saving as a draft (e.g. via the timer). If there isn't one yet, check "Create Sales Order" below instead of picking one here.
fields.label: Sales Order

fields.description: Creates and links a new Sales Order when this Site Visit is submitted, with the worked time (as the Activity Type's Dienstleistungsartikel) and any Additional Items as positions - instead of picking an existing Sales Order above.
fields.label: Create Sales Order

fields.description: Used as the new Sales Order's Customer's Purchase Order reference (po_no).
fields.label: Customer Reference

fields.description: Planned appointment window - independent of From Time/To Time below, which record when the visit actually happened. Set this to schedule a visit in advance and have it show up on the "Site Visit" calendar view; leave empty for a visit that is only recorded after the fact.
fields.label: Scheduled Start

fields.description: Not required - if empty, the automatically created Timesheet is created without an Employee (ERPNext's own Timesheet doctype does not require one either).
fields.label: Employee

fields.description: Controls the billing rate in the automatically created Timesheet. Must be set before submitting - not required yet when saving as a draft (e.g. via the timer).
fields.label: Activity Type

fields.description: Must be set before submitting - not required for a merely planned visit (see Scheduled Start)
fields.label: From Time

fields.description: Must be set before submitting - not required yet when saving as a draft (e.g. via the timer)
fields.label: To Time

fields.description: Pauses during the visit (break, or an emergency at another customer) - excluded from the billed working time. Filled via "Pause Timer"/"Resume Timer", not required.
fields.label: Breaks

fields.description: No physical visit took place - controls what happens with the signature (see Site Visit Settings).
fields.label: Remote Visit

fields.description: Check this to enter a Start Address below when not starting from the Default Start Address (Site Visit Settings) or the Company's default address for this visit - e.g. driving in from home or straight from the previous customer.
fields.label: Different Start Location

fields.description: Free-text address, no Address record required - search-as-you-type via OpenStreetMap. Overrides the default mileage start point (Site Visit Settings, or the Company's default address) for this visit only.
fields.label: Start Address

fields.description: Do not fall back to the customer's default address on file for mileage - e.g. because it is known to be wrong for this visit. Check this to enter a Customer Site Address below; without one, mileage cannot be calculated.
fields.label: Don't Use Customer's Default Address

fields.description: Free-text address, no Address record required. Overrides the customer's default address on file for this visit only - e.g. a remote office or a different site of the customer.
fields.label: Customer Site Address

fields.description: One-way driving distance to the customer's address, via the "Calculate Mileage" button (requires an OpenRouteService API key in Site Visit Settings).
fields.label: Distance (km)

fields.description: E.g. driving straight on to the next customer afterwards - bills only the one-way distance instead of a round trip (see Site Visit Settings -> Mileage Item).
fields.label: One-Way Trip Only

fields.description: Vor Ort zusaetzlich benoetigtes Material (z. B. Adapter, Kabel) - wird beim Buchen in den verknuepften Auftrag uebernommen.
fields.label: Additional Items

fields.description: Unterschrift per Finger/Stift/Maus auf dem Geraet des Technikers. Nicht pflicht, da der Kunde abwesend oder nicht bereit sein kann.
fields.label: Customer Signature

fields.description: Set when "Send Signing Link" was last used - the link stays valid for 30 days from this date.
fields.label: Signing Link Sent At

fields.description: Wird beim Buchen automatisch angelegt und verknuepft
fields.label: Timesheet

fields.description: Row name of the mileage line in the linked Sales Order - internal bookkeeping so re-syncing updates it instead of duplicating it.
fields.label: Mileage Sales Order Item
